_about.what: Fingerprints of the LangChain/LangGraph documentation pages that docs/decisions/special-agents-2026-08.md was verdicted against. The docs move; the verdicts do not. This file is what lets a reader say which version of each page a verdict was made against, and it is the weekly docs-watch's input.
_about.watcher: A weekly Claude scheduled task (.scratch/organisms-first-class/tickets/09-how-often-should-the-docs-watch-run.md). It reads this file, refetches every entry with "pinned": true via the docs-langchain MCP, and for each drift judges whether the change alters a verdict. It appends a dated section to special-agents-2026-08.md rather than editing a verdict in place, updates the pins below, and files a map ticket on a verdict-altering change.
_about.captured_by: .scratch/organisms-first-class/research/01-deepagents.md .. 05-concepts.md, each file's "## Pins" block. Values were transcribed from those blocks, not refetched — refetching later would pin a different document than the one that was verdicted.

fingerprint.bytes: wc -c of the .mdx as served by the docs-langchain MCP virtual filesystem
fingerprint.first_heading: the file's first line, which is the H1 on every swept page
fingerprint.changed_when: either field differs from the value recorded here
fingerprint.not_stored: the document itself, and no hash — bytes plus H1 detect a change without a copy, and both are readable in one MCP call

conventions.path: exactly as passed to the docs-langchain MCP
conventions.read: ISO date the fingerprint was captured
conventions.sweep_group: 1-5, the ticket 01-05 that read it; null when the path was fingerprinted in passing and no group swept it
conventions.verdict_section: the heading in the verdict document this pin backs; null when no verdict rests on it
conventions.pinned: true = the watcher refetches it. false = deliberately unpinned, and "excluded" says why. State names its exclusions so nobody re-adds one by accident.
conventions.no_non_finite: every value here is JSON-expressible; unbounded/absent is null, never Infinity or NaN

spot_checked.result: both reproduced the recorded bytes and first_heading exactly, so the scheme above is the scheme the research files used

stream_events_version.what: the version= argument every streaming tutorial in the sweep passes to stream_events(...)
stream_events_version.why: the version our SSE contract would be pinned against if ticket 24 adopts the library's event projection instead of deriving our own

deepagents_rag_rubric.what: the deepagents release the rubric pattern in /oss/python/deepagents/rag.mdx documents against
